Owned SmallV1 filesystem work previously quoted only its directory buffers. Store/Arc, cache/index/scan and name metadata could allocate outside that quote. This change requires an original-owner heap and existing-stack declaration before capture, derives the admitted layouts, preallocates bounded metadata and retains the original lease through destruction. Fixed scratch and bounded quota/eviction arrays preserve canonical identity, v1 bytes, victim order, verification, custody and the existing deadlines/security checks.

`OwnedStorePolicy::small_v1` adds `OwnedWorkspaceFunding` as its fourth argument. The installed consumer obtains the booked heap amount from its original current SmallV1 permit, checks immutable charge coverage and preserves the authenticated context and controller/reader owners. The 1 MiB workspace floor and separately paid 2 MiB execution class remain unchanged. Numeric declarations grant no authority; physical allocator/native-stack enforcement remains an original-owner precondition.

The layout model admits Rust1.97.1 commit8bab26f4 on Linux GNU/macOS x64/ARM64 and fails closed elsewhere for this owned policy. Ordinary Path/Windows has no added compiler restriction. The metadata witness requests a smaller1MiB thread and requires its native extent to stay within the unchanged2MiB declaration; it does not qualify a production pthread/physical bound.

Reviewed candidate `5152ef4f8f100f14aeff9cd352ad98643efaf3c5`, tree `4b3fb7cd2fa0fc71eda517cb7a83a68ac442127f`, adopts public contributor MVM [04a5e3e0](https://github.com/Casey-allard/mvm/commit/04a5e3e06f4fc48bc2c122518c42605b8032aa32), whose two SpiralCore dependencies use reviewed core `86497e88`. All active contributor references agree; the intentional journal bridge retains separately aliased upstream48fa5b and its byte-identity gate. This is frozen rc.3 fixture compatibility, not current-Ari owner adoption.

Validation:

- Exact-source core Wick qualification:543 transfer passes, four pre-existing ignored; one doctest;87 FlowMux passes; strict all-target checks;220 unchanged source inputs and81 executable identities.
- Current-head CI:40 successful checks, four manual SKIPPED/NOT_RUN. All seven native FlowMux rows pass87 FlowMux plus20 ordered controls each, metadata/layout and applicable Unix workspace controls. Their282 ZIP members and275 embedded checksums independently verify.
- Each row reconstructs67,108,864 bytes each direction with10,790,065 actual TLS bytes. Windows ARM records122.534585s lifecycle and90.734375s process CPU under the unchanged240s guard;2s operation guards remain.
- Three native installed-consumer rows each pass eight original reader/store controls, binding4,680 source files to MVM04a5. All nine consumer/parent/endpoint artifacts and the successful five fixture/five handoff controls independently review clear.
- Full serial default-profile MVM workspace/doctests pass:21,743 outer binary-harness executions and27 doctest executions;67/8 ignored remain explicit. Strict workspace Clippy, all-target and explicit BDD compile checks pass. These are execution counts, not deduplicated definitions.
- Installed witness and guest all-target compile checks pass. The original addressed journal restart/receipt regression passes with the same signed receipt, exact body/frame readback and actual Unix-socket counters. All485 final SDK inputs remain unchanged.

The canonical fixture's original E0061 is resolved through the real consumer, preserving one-byte-short refusal and custody assertions. Independent code/security and exact-source/native-artifact reviews are clear. Retained negative evidence includes the compiler RED, original macOS stack witness, incomplete release builds, stale cached source paths, genuine non-Git provenance refusal, generated bytecode cleanup and incomplete guest export. All4,680 MVM source inputs remain unchanged; the wrapper's exit1 on30 generated Python cache files is preserved alongside successful commands and verified cleanup. No assertion, source, signature, deadline or security check was weakened.

Contributes to #258; closes no full acceptance criterion or five-part #42 outcome. Ari alignment is checked through MVM7fe252a5: current endpoint/FlowMux ownership, independent grants, warm-claim audit identity and merged ADR-057/#5513's keyless host scheduler with VM-scoped keys. Proposed ADR-062/#5544's custody conflict remains a cutover gate. rc.4 runtime metadata is visible; signed-byte verification and compatible installed boot remain unqualified. Current-owner/original-enforcement, private MVMD, installed/native/WAN/capacity/security acceptance remain open. No final upstream MVM contribution.
